Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we dispute claim R-0000076, which was taken on 2014-07-30. The amount in dispute is $124.44. According to our records, the correct spoils allowance for this store and period is $94.27 (0.0100 of $9,427.20 invoiced). Therefore, the amount to repay is $30.17. The dispute deadline was 2015-01-26, and this deadline has passed.

We look forward to your prompt resolution.

Sincerely,

Northfield Pantry Co.
